______________________________________________________________________ ## 配置 ### 获取API令牌 在获取您的API代币 [https://6551.io/mcp](https://6551.io/mcp). 设置环境变量： ```bash # macOS / Linux export OPENNEWS_TOKEN="" # Windows PowerShell $env:OPENNEWS_TOKEN = "" ``` |变量|必填|描述| |----------|----------|-------------| | `OPENNEWS_TOKEN` | **是** |6551 API承载令牌（来自https://6551.io/mcp) | | `OPENNEWS_API_BASE` |否|覆盖REST API URL| | `OPENNEWS_WSS_URL` |否|覆盖WebSocket URL| | `OPENNEWS_MAX_ROWS` |否|每个请求的最大结果数（默认值100）| 还支持 `config.json` 在项目根目录中（环境变量优先）： ```json { "api_base_url": "https://ai.6551.io", "wss_url": "wss://ai.6551.io/open/news_wss", "api_token": "", "max_rows": 100 } ``` ______________________________________________________________________ ## WebSocket实时订阅 **端点**: `wss://ai.6551.io/open/news_wss?token=YOUR_TOKEN` 订阅实时加密货币新闻更新。 ### 订阅新闻 ```json { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "news.subscribe", "params": { "engineTypes": { "news": ["Bloomberg", "CoinDesk"], "onchain": [] }, "coins": ["BTC", "ETH"], "hasCoin": true } } ``` **回应**: ```json { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": { "success": true, "filters": { "engineTypes": {...}, "coins": [...], "hasCoin": true } } } ``` **滤波参数** （全部可选）： - `engineTypes`：将引擎类型映射到新闻类型代码的对象 - 关键字：发动机类型（例如。， `"news"`, `"onchain"`, `"listing"`, `"meme"`, `"market"`, `"prediction"`) - 值：新闻类型代码数组（例如。， `["Bloomberg", "CoinDesk"]`) - 空数组 `[]` 指该引擎下的所有新闻类型 - 使用 `list_news_types` 获取可用代码的工具 - `coins`：硬币符号阵列（例如。， `["BTC", "ETH"]`) - 按特定硬币过滤新闻 - 空数组 `[]` 或忽略接收所有硬币 - `hasCoin`：布尔值，如果为true，则仅接收带有硬币标签的新闻 ### 退订 ```json { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "news.unsubscribe" } ``` ### 服务器推送-新闻更新 当新消息与您的过滤器匹配时，服务器会推送： ```json { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "news.update", "params": { "id": "unique-article-id", "text": "Article title or content", "newsType": "Bloomberg", "engineType": "news", "link": "https://...", "coins": [ { "symbol": "BTC", "market_type": "cex", "match": "title" } ], "ts": 1708473600000 } } ``` ### 服务器推送-AI新闻更新 有关AI分析的新闻（如果订阅）： ```json { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "news.ai_update", "params": { "id": "unique-article-id", "text": "Article title", "newsType": "Bloomberg", "engineType": "news", "link": "https://...", "coins": [ { "symbol": "BTC", "market_type": "cex", "score": 85, "signal": "long", "grade": "A" }, { "symbol": "ETH", "market_type": "cex", "score": 45, "signal": "short", "grade": "B" } ], "aiRating": { "score": 85, "grade": "A", "signal": "long" }, "ts": 1708473600000 } } ``` ### 服务器推送-策略触发 > **需要Max订阅。** 在以下位置创建和管理您的策略 [https://www.newsliquid.com/strategy](https://www.newsliquid.com/strategy). 当用户定义的策略被触发时（例如价格警报、关键字匹配），服务器会推送： ```json { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "strategy.triggered", "params": { "id": 1234567890, "newsType": "strategy", "engineType": "market", "text": "BTC funding rate 0.15%", "link": "", "source": "binance", "description": "{...}", "coins": [ { "symbol": "BTC", "market_type": "cex" } ], "ts": "2025-01-15T08:30:00Z", "strategy": { "id": 42, "name": "BTC Funding Rate Alert", "sourceType": "market", "soundId": "alert-1", "bgColor": "#FF6B35", "metrics": { "funding_rate_high": { "value": 0.15, "unit": "%" } } }, "aiRating": { "score": 85 } } } ``` **策略参数字段**: - `id`：新闻/活动ID - `engineType`：源引擎类型(`market`, `news`, `onchain`) - `text`：人类可读的事件描述 - `coins`：相关硬币 - `ts`：事件时间戳 - `strategy.id`：用户策略ID - `strategy.name`：策略名称 - `strategy.sourceType`：策略源类型 - `strategy.soundId`：通知声音ID - `strategy.bgColor`：通知背景颜色 - `strategy.metrics`：带单位的触发度量值 - `aiRating` （可选）：当新闻有AI评分时显示。包含： - `score`：0-100影响评分 - `relatedAddress` （可选）：相关钱包地址（如适用） **备注**：策略触发事件通过NATS按用户推送。不需要显式订阅——事件会自动传递给拥有该策略的连接用户。 **备注**：每枚硬币 `coins` 数组现在包括单个AI评级： - `score`：此特定硬币的影响分数为0-100 - `signal`: `long` / `short` / `neutral` 对于这枚硬币 - `grade`: `A+` / `A` / `B+` / `B` / `C` 对于这枚硬币 顶级 `aiRating.score` 代表所有硬币中的最高分数。 ______________________________________________________________________ ## 数据结构 每篇文章返回： ```json { "id": "unique-article-id", "text": "Title / Content", "newsType": "Bloomberg", "engineType": "news", "link": "https://...", "coins": [ { "symbol": "BTC", "market_type": "cex", "match": "title", "score": 85, "signal": "long", "grade": "A" } ], "aiRating": { "score": 85, "grade": "A", "signal": "long", "status": "done", "summary": "Chinese summary", "enSummary": "English summary" }, "ts": 1708473600000 } ``` |AI字段|描述| |----------|-------------| | `score` |0-100影响分数（顶级=所有硬币中最高）| | `signal` | `long` （看涨）/ `short` （看跌）/ `neutral` | | `coins[].score` |个人硬币影响分数（0-100）| | `coins[].signal` |个人硬币信号（长/短/中性）| | `coins[].grade` |个人硬币等级（A+/A/B+/B/C）| ______________________________________________________________________ **Manual Installation for Other Clients (click to expand)** >
